definitions.explanation: The act of telling a story or relating events orally. Also refers to the narrative style or the narrator's voice in a performance or literary work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{語|かた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれた→引き込む：05736_hikikomu⟧。
examples.english: I was drawn into her narration.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{語|かた}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。

⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{語|かた}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother's narration of her wartime experiences was always deeply moving.

notes:
{語|かた}り is the noun form of ⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ (to narrate, to tell). It refers both to the act of narration and to the narrative itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語|かた}り{部|べ} (storyteller; keeper of oral tradition)
- {語|かた}り{口|くち} (way of speaking, narrative style)
- {語|かた}り{手|て} (narrator, storyteller)
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{語|かた}り (narration of a tale)

In traditional Japanese performing arts, {語|かた}り refers to the narrative component of forms like ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ and ⟦{浄瑠璃|じょうるり}→浄瑠璃：16585_joururi⟧, where a performer recites the story while others act or manipulate puppets.
